chunks.text: The problem for reinforcement learning algorithms is a Markov decision problem.

chunks.title: RL summary
chunks.text: And reinforcement learning algorithms solve them.

chunks.title: RL summary
chunks.text: Markov decision problem is defined by S, A, T, and R, where S is the potential

chunks.title: RL summary
chunks.text: states, A are the potential actions, T is a transition probability,

chunks.title: RL summary
chunks.text: which is given I'm in state S, I take action A, what's probability?

chunks.title: RL summary
chunks.text: I'll end up in state S prime.

chunks.title: RL summary
chunks.text: And R is the reward function.

chunks.title: RL summary
chunks.text: The goal for reinforcement learning algorithm is to find a policy pi that maps

chunks.title: RL summary
chunks.text: a state to an action that we should take.

chunks.title: RL summary
chunks.text: And its goal is to find this pi such that it maximizes some future sum

chunks.title: RL summary
chunks.text: of the reward.

chunks.title: RL summary
chunks.text: And we talked about that being either infinite horizon,

chunks.title: RL summary
chunks.text: fixed horizon, or discounted sum.

chunks.title: RL summary

chunks.title: RL summary

chunks.title: RL summary
